question: Which śaktis are enumerated as part of the nine powers?
premises: A group of nine śaktis is referenced
The list includes āpyāyinī, candrikā, and hlādinī
inference: Āpyāyinī, candrikā, hlādinī and others form the nine śaktis
uncertainties: Only three of the nine śaktis are named in this verse
plain_english: Āpyāyinī, Candrikā, and Hlādinī are among the nine śaktis.
